title: Help, knowledge and agent instructions
description: Use when reading or curating LPM guidance: search help articles (ajuda) for a rule, register or delete knowledge items or project files, manage project skills contexts (agent instructions), or draft, accept or reject roadmap knowledge notes. Not for activity evidence (use lpm-deliver-activity).
doneWhen: The rule was found and cited by slug, or the knowledge object/skills context/roadmap note is in the requested state on re-list.
authorityCeiling: Reads and registrations are [A]; deletes, skills-context writes and roadmap-knowledge accept/reject are [C]; defaultModel changes are the owner's.
jobs: procure na ajuda do projeto a regra de fechamento de atividade e cite o slug
what does the project help say about baseline approval?
registre este PDF já publicado na base de conhecimento do projeto
register the uploaded file link in the project files
remove the duplicate knowledge item <name> from project <projectId>
atualize as instruções de agente (skills context) do projeto
save the analysis of roadmap item <itemId> as a knowledge note for the owner to review
aceite a nota de conhecimento do roadmap como rascunho no projeto <projectId>
reject the roadmap knowledge draft <artifactId>: it is outdated

notFor.when: proof of work on an activity (screenshots, logs, test reports)
WhatsApp or protocol media of an intake entry
AISH delivery artifacts or a DoD audit
reading a roadmap analysis or asking a code question without saving a note
requirements, baselines, change sets or baseline publication
roadmap records or a roadmap change request
the AI model, AI budget or AI policy of the workspace
